Pre-registered stable vulnerable release: tag openssl-3.5.8 resolves to f4dc4d58b48d346a8270183f89acf826d459b0ca (released 2026-08-25). The OpenSSL security advisory of 2026-09-29 lists every supported 3.5 user as vulnerable and names 3.5.9 as the fixed release; the NVD configurations for that batch state versionStartIncluding 3.5.0 and versionEndExcluding 3.5.9 and publish fix commits. The tag was chosen from the release and advisory metadata, before any repository candidate was examined, so it satisfies the pre-registration rule rather than fitting a version to evidence. The batch is version-spanning: thirteen of the fourteen CVEs carry the 3.5.0 <= v < 3.5.9 range in their NVD configuration, while CVE-2026-84783 is 4.0.0 <= v < 4.0.3 only. The sweep of the frozen 3.5.8 tree therefore produces thirteen of the fourteen batch ids as candidates, not fourteen.
